newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends steady in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.18 to the dollar on Monday but may open lower on Tuesday amid a rising demand for the dollar compared to low supplies, dealers said.
They said the demand for the dollar was rising because of concerns about Pakistan's economy after the Intrnatonal Monetary Fund decided last week to suspend a standby loan to the country.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.70 percent. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
